## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` passes
- [ ] `cargo test` passes

- [ ] `README.md` / `--help` text updated if user-facing behavior changed
- [ ] `Cargo.toml` version bumped if this is a release
